title: Pan-Seared Beef Bourguignon
description: A classic French dish made with tender beef and a rich, flavorful sauce. Perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: 1 pound beef (skirt or flank steak), cut into 2-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Choose a tougher cut for maximum flavor

ingredients.name: 1 tablespoon browned butter
ingredients.notes: Browned butter adds a nutty flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: 1 onion, thinly sliced
ingredients.notes: Yellowed onions are perfect for caramelizing

ingredients.name: 2 cloves garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic to prevent overpowering the dish

ingredients.name: 1 cup beef broth
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality broth for maximum flavor

ingredients.name: 1 cup red wine
ingredients.notes: Red wine adds depth and richness to the sauce

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon dried thyme
ingredients.notes: Thyme is a classic herb used in French cooking

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper is a must

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality flour for the best texture

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of browned butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, red wine, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
Serve the beef and sauce over egg noodles or mashed potatoes.
Garnish with fresh thyme, if desired.
